_comment: Human overrides for the auto-generated repository cards. Anything set here wins over detection. Keys are repository names exactly as they appear on GitHub. Delete a key to fall back to auto-detection. This file is committed, so every override is versioned and reviewable.

_fields.language: Override the detected primary language (e.g. when bundled HTML outweighs the real source).
_fields.stack: Replace the detected tech stack entirely, in display order.
_fields.hide: true to keep the repo out of the card grid.
_fields.pin: Sort key. Lower numbers appear first; unpinned repos follow by recency.
